summary: The note describes Foligno Cathedral, a Roman Catholic cathedral on Piazza della Repubblica in central Foligno, Italy. It was built on the site of an earlier basilica and is dedicated to the city's patron saint, the martyr Felician of Foligno (San Feliciano), who was buried there in 251 AD. The cathedral is the seat of the Bishop of Foligno.
one_line: Foligno Cathedral is the Roman Catholic cathedral in central Foligno, Italy, dedicated to the martyr Saint Felician and seat of the Bishop of Foligno.
key_facts: Foligno Cathedral is a Roman Catholic cathedral.

Foligno Cathedral is dedicated to the patron saint of Foligno, the martyr Felician of Foligno (San Feliciano).
Felician of Foligno was buried in the cathedral in 251 AD.
Foligno Cathedral is the seat of the Bishop of Foligno.
